result.instructions: Tools for TOConline, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my TOConline customers and find one by tax number."; "Which sales invoices are still open?"; "Show the line items on a sales document.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TOConline data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run toconline_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run toconline_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run toconline_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. toconline_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: toconline_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the connected TOConline company's customers. Returns the vendor's JSON:API data, attributes, relationships and pagination metadata. Read-only. GET /api/customers.

filters.description: Exact-match JSON:API filters, e.g. {tax_registration_number:'123456789'} for customers, {item_code:'100'} for products, or {document_no:'FT 2026/1',status:1} for documents. Names must be fields of this resource; invalid fields are rejected by TOConline.
